update.title: Made the portfolio timeline richer and easier to navigate
update.summary: Reworked timeline entries to match each project’s prominence, support animated previews and expandable icon bundles, and preserve filters and selections in shareable URLs.

preview.description: Portfolio Site timeline combining compact update rows with a full media card.

blocks.body:
## Give each timeline item the right amount of space

I replaced the timeline’s one-size-fits-all markup with a shared entry renderer used by the timeline, featured work, and standalone cards. Projects can appear as a full media card, a compact preview, or a small icon-and-title row, while GIF and video previews follow the same media path as static images.

blocks.code:
flowchart LR
  Data[Project data] --> Entry[Shared entry renderer]
  Entry --> Large[Large media card]
  Entry --> Compact[Compact preview]
  Entry --> Small[Small icon row]
  Small --> Bundle[Expandable bundle]
  Timeline[Filters and selection] --> Bundle
  Timeline --> URL[Shareable URL state]
blocks.description: Shared project data controls presentation depth, while timeline filters and selections remain addressable through the URL.

blocks.body:
## Keep filtering and bundling in sync

Small entries can combine into expandable bundles with an icon strip. Bundling is recalculated after filters are applied, so a narrow result returns to a normal entry instead of leaving a misleading group. The URL preserves the selected tags, project group, and entry, along with whether connecting lines are shown by shared tag, by project group, or hidden. The same timeline view can therefore be reopened directly.
